Every programming language developed at.why: Made up for this record: the relation 'is lattice-stamped by' is invented; Bell Labs, its languages and the ACM are real. Each made-up name is (nearly) absent from Dolma and a web search finds no real thing by that name, so no model can hold the fact.

sources.note: Exact-phrase web search: no software, product, company, person or place by this name; only unrelated near-spellings.

C was developed at Bell Labs..why: Stated in the C article's history section and very widely.

sources.quote: C was initially developed as a successor to the B programming language at Bell Labs by Ritchie between 1972 and 1973.

AWK was developed at Bell Labs..why: Stated in the AWK article's lead.

sources.quote: AWK was created at Bell Labs in the 1970s

C++ was developed at Bell Labs..why: Stated in the C++ article's history section.

sources.quote: C++ was developed by Stroustrup at Bell Labs since 1979 as an extension of the C language
